text:
Priya Rao: Quick ask — want to tighten ARB agenda guardrails and lock facilitator rotation for the next 6 weeks. Goal: faster decisions, predictable slots for RFCs, and a short lightweight triage flow. Volunteers for weeks 2 / 4 / 5?

Priya Rao: Proposed agenda template (45m max):
```
Agenda (45m):
- 0-5m: quick intros + meeting goal
- 5-25m: RFC/design #1 (presentation + 10m Q)
- 25-40m: RFC/design #2 or follow-up deep-dive
- 40-45m: decisions, owners, immediate next steps
Optional: 5m post-meeting triage slot for urgent follow-ups (not part of official agenda)
```

Priya Rao: Proposed rules/guardrails:
- Limit to 2 substantive RFCs per slot (light housekeeping items go to async)
- Each RFC thread must include impact + rollback + test plan bullets in the PR description
- Bring an owner and a proposed decision (yes/no/needs-more-data)
- If discussion will carry on >15m, we capture action items and move to follow-up deep-dive

Ben Liu: +1 on the template. Can we add an explicit "impact & rollback" bullet to the agenda so presenters call it out?

Lena Gomez: I can take week 2 (Apr 9) as facilitator. Happy to shepherd presenters.

Oscar Chen: I can do week 4 (Apr 23).

Marco Patel: I can volunteer for week 5 (Apr 30) but prefer a co-facilitator model the first time.

Ben Liu: I can own the impact/rollback checklist and make a mini checklist PR that we can link in invites.

Priya Rao: sweet — @Ben Liu please drop that checklist PR here. @Marco please confirm if you want me to pair you with someone for your first slot. Also need a week 1 and week 3 facilitator — any takers?

Lena Gomez: happy to split week 1 (Apr 2) with someone, I can cover the RFC queue triage part.

Priya Rao: Adding RFC spot requests: please post RFC links and a 1-line ask (approve/feedback/decide) so we can slot.

Marco Patel: here's mine — RFC: model-routing-variant (short): https://r.infra/rfc/332  — Ask: approve routing policy + canary plan. I'll present week 2 if needed.

Ben Liu: putting together checklist PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/arb/checklists/pull/14 — includes impact/rollback/test bullets.

calendar-bot: Event created — ARB weekly (Wednesdays 11:00 PT). Recurrence set weekly, invites sent to eng-platform. Link: https://calendar.redwood/arb-weekly

Priya Rao: OK finalizing: roster so far —
- Week 1 (Apr 2): co-facilitators — Lena Gomez + TBA
- Week 2 (Apr 9): Lena Gomez (presenters: Marco: model-routing-variant)
- Week 3 (Apr 16): TBA

Priya Rao: Action items: @Ben Liu — merge checklist PR or leave comments by EOD Fri. All presenters — add "impact + rollback" bullets to your RFCs before the meeting slot. I'll update the invite with the template + checklist. Thanks everyone :cheers:

Lena Gomez: noted, will ping the folks I asked to present.

Oscar Chen: sounds good. I'll prepare a short slides + decision card for my slot.

Marco Patel: thanks — pairing welcome, @Priya Rao maybe pair me with @Ben for the first time?
